scope: A dedicated optional five- or ten-minute listening/speaking path with original scenes, saved work and a later-day changed situation.
entry: Today has a visible short-session alternative; More practice & materials also links to #listen-speak.

content.source: Newly authored public companion practice; no publisher audio, worksheet text or private book extraction added to the app.

behaviour: Five minutes: main-idea comprehension and a changed-detail retelling. Ten minutes also includes a detail check. Times are suggestions, with no countdown or correctness gate.
A run retains its chosen duration and scene. Choice selections, written drafts and self-checks survive reload; submitted first responses are immutable.
Opening scene text or a model records support for subsequent first checks. Replaying the device voice is separate. Earlier first checks keep their original support record.
Italian sentence frames remain visible in either interface language, with optional English translation. Full model use is recorded separately.
A new situation becomes available from the calendar day after completion. Its draft, model use, self-checks and completion date remain separate from the first task.
Weekly evidence identifies first comprehension responses, text support, self-checked runs and later-day self-checked responses without inferring speaking improvement.
The optional path keeps the ordinary plan, active programme, XP and scheduled-minute totals unchanged.

Version-one backups remain compatible. Oral practice has a bounded optional field; merge keeps whole local overlapping runs and adds missing runs. A union exceeding 200 runs is refused without dropping either backup's work.
The existing local-audio workspace retains its tab-local privacy rules; its recordings and pasted transcripts are not moved into saved oral practice.
reviewRepairs: Render the Italian sentence frame in English UI so learners do not need to expose the full model to obtain an Italian scaffold.
Move keyboard focus to first-check feedback when the Check button is removed, using stable primitive dependencies so subsequent transcript opening retains its own focus.
Explain the 200-run merged-capacity limit accurately instead of presenting it as a damaged-record validation error.
Use the existing primary button style for the selected duration; a weaker local selector was overridden by the global secondary-button theme.

validation.offlineScope: Nine lazy routes, an existing guided-session draft and a new oral-practice choice survive offline reload; cache removal preserves progress.
validation.finalDurationVisualCheck: Passed computed colour distinction and selected5/10 screenshots at320px on the final build; six full learner workflows preceded this isolated style correction.

realLearnerEvaluation.status: Not performed; agent simulations and browser tests verify behaviour, not learning gains.
suggestedPersonalTrial: Complete one five-minute A1 scene; record whether text or model support was needed and whether the instructions were clear.
On a later day, try its changed situation before reopening earlier notes, then self-check or discuss it with a teacher/conversation partner.
Compare which details and forms needed help. Use that feedback to choose further practice; do not treat task length, XP or a single correct choice as fluency evidence.
realLearnerEvaluation.collection: No analytics, participant recruitment or messaging has been added. Any evaluation requires voluntary learner participation.

limits: The three scenes are a small practice set, not a complete listening/speaking curriculum or a proficiency test.
Speech synthesis availability and pronunciation quality vary by device; some voices need a network. Browser checks verify playback intent and fallback behaviour, not acoustic quality.
Changed-detail retelling is scaffolded and self-assessed; the app does not record or automatically grade speech.
Return tasks use a simple next-day availability rule; the app does not claim an optimal retention interval or a validated adaptive learning algorithm.
Completed work is retained, with new runs paused at 200. Users should keep progress exports; browser storage can be cleared by the device.
